description: Get a checkout link for the $0.99, 24-hour Day Pass by card or PayPal, including in a fresh session. Creating the link never charges anyone; payment requires completing checkout. Optional workflow_id targets a closed run; sponsor:true explicitly sponsors another team's run without transferring branding ownership. Required arguments: .

_caller_label.description: Optional caller label recorded as a caller-reported claim in the receipt.

_continuity_ai_label.description: Optional self-reported AI client label for the private continuity timeline. Zambo does not independently verify the client.

_ref.description: Optional handover referral ID from your install link.

_session_id.description: Optional stable bot-job ID. Reuse it across calls to bind a Day Pass and keep the job ledger together.

_zambo_key.description: Optional opaque Zambo access capability. Never place it in a URL or public log.

human_approved.description: Optional confirmation that the person requested a link. Creating a link never charges them.

sponsor.description: Explicitly sponsor a closed workflow owned by another session; this never grants branding access.

workflow_id.description: Optional closed workflow to seal after payment.

workflow_manage_token.description: Optional private workflow capability. Never share it in public.

name: day_pass_checkout_link

result.description: The tool's observed JSON value or plain-text result.
